name: Madame Eva
summary: In Darkshire, Madame Eva’s readings mark her as a revered matriarch. She practices ancient divination and cartomancy, and is often the first in town to sense unnatural disturbances across Duskwood. Townspeople and travelers seek her help with grim mysteries and occult charms against the creeping dark.

sections.title: The Fortune-Teller of Darkshire
sections.body: Madame Eva reads cards and practices ancient folk rituals in Darkshire. Many in Stormwind’s cathedral would view her ways with suspicion. In a region troubled by feral beasts, the undead, and darker horrors, desperate townspeople and visiting adventurers seek her eerie insights.

sections.title: Ties of Blood and Prophecy
sections.body: Madame Eva is devoted to her family, including her granddaughter Alyssa Eva and young Lohgan. When her cards reveal dark omens threatening Alyssa, Eva enlists passing wanderers to scour the woods and uncover long-buried tragedies before history can repeat itself.

sections.title: Weaving Protection Against the Night
sections.body: Madame Eva’s knowledge reaches beyond card reading to ritual craft and warding. She spins Ghost Hair Thread from a spirit’s hair and makes folk relics such as the Totem of Infliction. Few in town understand the strange, twilight logic of Duskwood’s restless spirits as well as she does.

faq.answer: Madame Eva is an elderly human fortune-teller and diviner who lives in Darkshire. Through cartomancy and ancient folk crafts, she seeks glimpses of the unseen perils stalking Duskwood.

faq.q: What is Madame Eva's role in the mystery of Stalvan?
aliases: why does eva care about stalvan
faq.answer: Madame Eva reads the cards and senses an imminent supernatural danger around her granddaughter Alyssa. Her readings guide adventurers to investigate forgotten documents and trails, uncovering the grim history of Stalvan Mistmantle.

faq.q: Is Madame Eva a witch or a mage?
faq.answer: Eva is a seer who practices older mystic arts, including cartomancy, spirit-thread weaving, and folk effigies. Her magic follows traditional fortune-telling and occult lore, unlike the structured arcanum of Dalaran or the Holy Light.

faq.q: Who is related to Madame Eva in Darkshire?
faq.answer: Madame Eva is the grandmother of Alyssa Eva and Lohgan Eva. Watcher Eva, who serves in the town’s Night Watch, is believed to share family ties with her.

faq.q: What is Ghost Hair Thread used for?
faq.answer: Madame Eva spins Ghost Hair Thread from the hair of a restless spirit. She says it has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects, and makes it for those who bring her the ghost hair she needs.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva craft the Totem of Infliction?
faq.answer: Madame Eva crafts the Totem of Infliction as a dark, sympathetic effigy. Bound with specific creature materials, it directs curses and harm back onto the fell beasts terrorizing the woods.

angles.text: For Alliance champions entering Duskwood’s oppressive shadow, Madame Eva is an indispensable guide. Her premonitions cut through the deadly confusion of the woods.
The Holy Light brings solace to the living. Priests may find Eva’s cartomancy and use of spirit remnants an earthen counterpoint to traditional church liturgy.
Tailors may value Eva’s knowledge of strange weaving materials. She works spectral thread plucked directly from the ghosts of the region.
